```r
library(effsize2GLM)
```

This vignette walks through the original example scenarios for translating
solicited study parameters into effect size summaries.

## Example 1: three groups, binary outcome

```r
ex1 <- obtainPhiAndR2(
  muCMs = c(.3, .2, .2),             # saturated means: mu2, mu1, mu0
  piCP  = c(.3, .3, .4),             # cell proportions
  Zmat  = matrix(rep(1, 3), nrow = 3), # intercept-only null model
  dispersion = 1,
  fam = quasi(link = "logit", variance = "mu(1-mu)")
)
ex1$phi.x.z
ex1$R2.x.z
```

## Example 2: 2x2 factorial, binary outcome

```r
ex2 <- obtainPhiAndR2(
  muCMs = c(.4, .2, .3, .2), # mu11, mu10, mu01, mu00
  piCP  = c(.25, .25, .25, .25),
  Zmat  = matrix(c(1,0,
                   1,0,
                   0,1,
                   0,1),
                 nrow = 4, byrow = TRUE),
  dispersion = 1,
  fam = quasi(link = "logit", variance = "mu(1-mu)")
)
ex2$phi.x.z
ex2$R2.x.z
```

## Example 2a: 2x2 factorial, main-effects alternative

```r
ex2a <- obtainPhiAndR2(
  muCMs = c(.4, .2, .3, .2), # mu11, mu10, mu01, mu00
  piCP  = c(.25, .25, .25, .25),
  Zmat  = matrix(c(1,0,
                   1,0,
                   0,1,
                   0,1),
                 nrow = 4, byrow = TRUE),
  XZmat = matrix(c(1,0,1,
                   1,0,0,
                   0,1,1,
                   0,1,0),
                 nrow = 4, byrow = TRUE),
  dispersion = 1,
  fam = quasi(link = "logit", variance = "mu(1-mu)")
)
ex2a$phi.x.z
ex2a$R2.x.z
```

## Example 3: two groups, gamma-type outcome

```r
ex3 <- obtainPhiAndR2(
  muCMs = c((1 - .15) * exp(.25), exp(.25)), # mu1, mu0
  piCP  = c(.67, .33),
  Zmat  = matrix(rep(1, 2), nrow = 2), # intercept-only null model
  dispersion = 0.58^2,
  fam = quasi(link = "log", variance = "mu^2")
)
ex3$phi.x.z
ex3$R2.x.z
```
